A '''claymore''' is a melee weapon that can be found within various {{MCD|mission}}s. Its unique variants are the {{MCD|broadsword}}, the {{MCD|heartstealer}}, the {{MCD|great axeblade}}, and the {{MCD|frost slayer}}. It is the only item in the game to have 4 unique variations.

==Obtaining==
===Missions===
*{{DuLevelLink|Obsidian Pinnacle}}
*{{DuLevelLink|???}}
*{{DuLevelLink|Gauntlet of Gales}}
*{{DuLevelLink|Gale Sanctum}} (DLC)
*{{DuLevelLink|Tower}}

===Merchants===
*{{DuEntityLink|Village Merchant}}
*{{DuEntityLink|Gift Wrapper}}
*{{DuEntityLink|Mystery Merchant}}
*{{DuEntityLink|Luxury Merchant}}
*{{DuEntityLink|Piglin Merchant}}

===Ancients===
*{{DuEntityLink|First Enchanter}}
*{{DuEntityLink|Unbreakable One}}

==Usage==
Claymores possess high power, low speed, and moderate range, and has a combo consisting of a slash, thrust, and a slam. The slash deals the weapon's minimum melee damage, the thrust does about 20% more damage, and the slam does the weapon's maximum melee damage.

===Properties===
*X melee damage
*Powerful pushback
